The '''Mandalorian cruiser''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] design used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==History==
[[File:MandoCruiser-NGO.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Mandalorian cruiser in the [[Barma sector/Legends|Barma sector]]]]

These cruisers took part in the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], which resulted in a major military and economic crisis for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TL1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> This blockade was later broken by [[Hylo Visz]] and her band of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], when they aided the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] in besting the Mandalorian fleet.<ref name="TL2" />
